simple.prompt: Negative inversion with 'Not only': 'Not only ___ the data thoroughly, but they also uncovered fraud.'
simple.explanation: Not only di awal klausa mewajibkan inversi pola pertanyaan: auxiliary (did) + subjek (they) + verb dasar (audit).

simple.prompt: Inversion with 'Under no circumstances': 'Under no circumstances ___ unauthorized personnel enter the reactor room.'
simple.explanation: Under no circumstances + modal (may) + subjek (unauthorized personnel) + verb (enter).

simple.targetSentence: Rarely has such profound scientific progress been accomplished.
simple.explanation: Rarely + has (auxiliary) + such profound scientific progress (subject) + been accomplished (verb).
hints: Subjek dan pasif: 'such profound scientific progress been accomplished'.

simple.prompt: Inversion with 'Little': 'Little ___ that his research would ignite a medical revolution.'
simple.explanation: 'Little did + subject + verb' adalah formula klasik penekanan ketidaktahuan total di masa lalu.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi penekanan 'At no time'.
simple.targetSentence: At no time did the witnesses contradict their testimony.
simple.explanation: At no time + did the witnesses contradict + their testimony.
hints: Mulai dengan 'At no time did the witnesses'.

simple.prompt: Inversion with 'Seldom': 'Seldom ___ an orator captivate an audience so thoroughly.'
simple.explanation: Present simple habit/ability: Seldom + does + an orator (subjek tunggal) + captivate (verb dasar).

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi dengan 'No sooner... than'.
simple.targetSentence: No sooner had the treaty been signed than border clashes ceased.
simple.explanation: No sooner had the treaty been signed + than border clashes ceased.
hints: Mulai dengan 'No sooner had the treaty been signed'.

dialogue: Has any administration ever faced such multifaceted crises?
Never before in the annals of the republic ___ the sovereign institutions been tested so severely.
intermediate.explanation: Never before + auxiliary (have) + the sovereign institutions (subjek jamak) + been tested.

intermediate.prompt: Fronting an adjective for dramatic emphasis: '___ were his rhetorical gifts that even sworn adversaries were swayed.'
intermediate.explanation: Pola: 'So + adjective + were/was + subject + that...': 'So persuasive were his rhetorical gifts that...'.
hints: Pola: So + adj + to be + subject + that...

intermediate.prompt: Such inversion: '___ was the severity of the frost that citrus groves across the province perished.'
intermediate.explanation: Pola: 'Such + was/were + noun phrase + that...': 'Such was the severity of the frost that...'.

intermediate.targetSentence: Only when the audit was finalized did management realize the deficit.
intermediate.explanation: Only when the audit was finalized (adverbial clause) + did management realize (inversion) + the deficit.
hints: Mulai dengan anak kalimat waktu: 'Only when the audit was finalized'.
Inversi klausa utama: 'did management realize the deficit'.

intermediate.prompt: Inversion with comparative clause: 'The president delivered an address, as ___ all prime ministers before him.'
intermediate.explanation: Dalam klausa komparatif formal dengan 'as' atau 'than', inversi subjek-auxiliary lazim digunakan: 'as had all prime ministers...'.

intermediate.targetSentence: So profound was his grief that he retired from public life.
intermediate.explanation: So profound was his grief + that he retired from public life.
hints: Mulai dengan 'So profound was his grief'.
Klausa konsekuensi: 'that he retired from public life'.

dialogue: Could the unauthorized intruder gain access without hardware tokens?
On no account ___ the internal firewall permit external administrative logins.
intermediate.explanation: 'On no account will the firewall permit...' melarang keras akses dengan penekanan inversi modal.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan penempatan inversi pada klausa 'Only after'.
complex.draft: Only after did the regulatory body investigate the bank the accounts were unfreezed.
options: Only after the regulatory body investigated the bank were the accounts unfrozen.
Only after did the body investigate the bank were the accounts unfreezed.
Only after the body investigated did the accounts unfroze.
complex.explanation: Pada konstruksi 'Only after [clause]', klausa 'after' tetap menggunakan urutan kata normal (the regulatory body investigated). Inversi HANYA terjadi pada klausa utama: 'were the accounts unfrozen'. Selain itu, bentuk V3 dari freeze adalah 'unfrozen' (bukan unfreezed).

complex.prompt: Rhetorical stylistics: What distinct communicative value does inversion impart in formal and literary English?
options: It elevates informational salience, crafts dramatic suspense, and marks high rhetorical solemnity.
It converts declarative statements into colloquial jokes.
It is a syntactic error that authors try to hide.
complex.explanation: Inversi mengangkat derajat keterlihatan informasi (salience), menciptakan ketegangan artistik/dramatik, dan memberikan wibawa retoris tingkat tinggi.
hints: Meningkatkan bobot retoris dan ketegangan artistik.
Pilih opsi elevates informational salience and rhetorical solemnity.

complex.prompt: Inversion with participle fronting: '___ atop the ancient marble plinth was the bronze bust of Caesar.'
complex.explanation: Participle fronting (memajukan kata kerja past participle ke depan kalimat untuk efek dramatis): 'Perched atop the ancient plinth was...'.
hints: Participle pasif di awal kalimat mendahului to be.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat participle fronting sastra formal.
complex.targetSentence: Hanging from the gilded ceiling was a magnificent Venetian chandelier.
complex.explanation: Hanging from the gilded ceiling + was (verb) + a magnificent Venetian chandelier (subject).
hints: Mulai dengan participle tempat: 'Hanging from the gilded ceiling'.
Verb dan subjek: 'was a magnificent Venetian chandelier'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi struktur inversi komparatif ganda yang cacat.
complex.draft: So heavy the snowfall was that the mountain pass was closed for a fortnight.
options: So heavy was the snowfall that the mountain pass was closed for a fortnight.
Such heavy was the snowfall that the pass was closed.
So was the heavy snowfall that the mountain pass was closed.
complex.explanation: Pola baku: 'So + adjective (heavy) + was (verb) + the snowfall (subject) + that...'. Menempatkan subjek sebelum 'was' menghilangkan efek inversi yang dituju.
hints: Ganti menjadi 'So heavy was the snowfall'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence with impeccable formal correlative inversion:
options: Not until the final ballots were tallied did either candidate concede defeat.
Not until were the final ballots tallied did the candidate concede.
Not until the final ballots tallied the candidate conceded.
complex.explanation: Urutan sintaksis sempurna: 'Not until [normal clause] did [subject] [base verb]'.
hints: Sintaksis sempurna: inversi pada klausa utama.

dialogue: Can the executive order override statutory enactments?
In no historical precedent ___ the executive claimed such unfettered prerogative.
complex.explanation: In no historical precedent + auxiliary has + the executive (subjek) + claimed (V3).
hints: Inversi preseden sejarah dengan auxiliary has.
